verdict.rationale: Letta clearly supports adding memories from conversations: `/remember` commits lessons to MemFS, and dreaming subagents review recent conversations to consolidate memory. That memory persists across sessions, computers and interfaces. Semantic retrieval is not built in, though: the docs say keyword and optional semantic or hybrid search require installing the separate MemFS Search mod, and Letta staff describe the memory system as primarily text/files-based rather than RAG. Missing for 10: built-in semantic search, documentation of how the MemFS Search mod's semantic retrieval works and how well it recalls, and independent hands-on corroboration of recall quality.
